title: Introduce Yourself
text: Hello, my name is Anna. I am from China. I am a student. Nice to meet you.

title: Daily Greetings
text: Good morning! How are you today? I am fine, thank you. How about you?

title: Talking About Your Family
text: There are four people in my family. My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. I have one little sister. We love each other.

title: Ordering Food at a Restaurant
text: I would like a chicken sandwich and a glass of juice, please. How much is it? It is eight dollars.

title: Asking the Time
text: Excuse me, what time is it? It is half past eight. Thank you very much. You are welcome.

title: Going to School
text: I go to school by bus every day. It takes about twenty minutes. Classes start at eight o’clock.

title: Talking About the Weather
text: The weather is sunny and warm today. Let us go to the park and have a picnic. That sounds great!

title: My Hobby
text: My hobby is swimming. I swim every Saturday morning at the sports center. It keeps me healthy and strong.

title: Shopping for Clothes
text: How much is this blue shirt? It is twenty dollars. It fits me well. I will take it, thank you.

title: Weekend Plans
text: On the weekend, I will visit my grandparents. We will have lunch together and talk about my school life.
